wargearItems.effectsHtml:

  • Increase weapon's Strength characteristic by 1

effects: Cannot be equipped by a model with the Mounted keyword
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Wounds characteristic by 2
  • Cannot be equipped by a model with the Mounted keyword

wargearItems.name: Vexilla
effects: While a model equipped with a Vexilla is on the battlefield and positioned wholly within range of an objective marker, add 30 Wounds to the total Wounds count when determining which player controls that objective for the purpose of scoring Primary Objective Victory Points.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: While a model equipped with a Vexilla is on the battlefield and positioned wholly within range of an objective marker, add 30 Wounds to the total Wounds count when determining which player controls that objective for the purpose of scoring Primary Objective Victory Points.

wargearItems.name: Allarus Terminator Armour
effects: Ignore the effects of the Heavy keyword when making Attacks
Models equipped with Terminator armour count as 2 models for the purposes of the Transport ability
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Strength characteristic by 1
  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Increase Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Initiative Characteristic by 1
  • Increase Armour Save characteristic to 2+
  • Ignore the effects of the Heavy keyword when making Attacks
  • Add the Deep Strike ability
  • Models equipped with Terminator armour count as 2 models for the purposes of the Transport ability

wargearItems.name: Dawneagle Jetbike
effects: Replace weapons equipped by the model with the following:
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Movement characteristic to 14"
  • Increase Toughness characteristic to 8
  • Add the Mounted keyword
  • Add the Deep Strike keyword
  • Replace weapons equipped by the model with the following:
  • 1 Interceptor Lance
  • 1 of the following:
  • Hurricane Bolter
  • Cyclone Missile Launcher

wargearItems.name: Smoke Launchers
effects: The bearer can make 2 Smoke Grenades attacks as part of a Shoot action.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer can make 2 Smoke Grenades attacks as part of a Shoot action.
